propositions: Eval harnesses hard-code repository paths under docs/experiments/ and must be refactored to accept configurable corpus roots with client projects supplying custom criteria
evals_corpus_root() must be the sole function resolving replay cache, output, ledger, and project eval-spec roots, defaulting to .rebar/evals with no config
The research corpus tree docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/ must be moved to a top-level evals/ directory with rebar.toml setting corpus_root = evals
The 13 MB research artefacts currently under docs/ must be relocated and excluded from the shipped Python package to prevent bloat in distributions
Client-facing documentation for running eval harnesses against custom criteria must be added to docs/llm-framework.md and docs/user-guide.md with override precedence and output paths explained
